notes.title: How This Page Is Organized
items: The Dream-Eaters runs as two linked four-scenario campaigns played in alternating order instead of one continuous line.
This page keeps one shared overview and timeline, then splits the run into separate Dream-Quest and Web of Dreams track sections.
Each track should keep its own story notes, campaign log, chaos bag notes, scenario results, and deck upgrade history.

notes.title: Background
items: Friday, February 13th, 1925. Virgil Gray's impossible dream account in Tales from Nevermore spreads through Arkham and triggers a wider outbreak of shared dreams.

Letters pour into the paper from readers who claim they experienced the very same impossible dream, turning Virgil's story from a curiosity into a citywide phenomenon that even the Arkham Advertiser cannot ignore.
Doctors, academics, and skeptics dismiss the event as shared hysteria, but the investigators remain unconvinced and decide to test whether the Dreamlands are real rather than merely symbolic.

notes.title: Dream-Quest Setup
items: Virgil Gray and many of the affected dreamers are committed for treatment after failing to wake properly from the strange shared visions.
The investigators reconstruct Virgil's circumstances as faithfully as possible in hopes of reproducing the same crossing between the waking world and the Dreamlands.
Half the party prepares to cross into the Dreamlands directly, while the waking-world team will remain behind and begin its own linked campaign separately.

notes.title: Background
items: Friday, February 13th, 1925. While the dreamers attempt to reproduce Virgil Gray's crossing, the waking-world investigators remain in Arkham to watch over them and respond if the experiment goes wrong.
Something does go wrong: the sleepers fail to wake naturally, their condition worsens, and the waking-world team is forced into its own linked investigation alongside the dream journey.

notes.title: Web Of Dreams Setup
items: The waking-world team begins by studying the dreamers' physical condition, guarding them, and trying to understand whether the shared visions have opened some path between worlds.
This parallel campaign follows the consequences in Arkham while the Dream-Quest investigators disappear into the Dreamlands.

items: The Dream-Quest investigators continued their search for Kadath by traveling across multiple distant regions of the Dreamlands.
During the investigation, they made their way through Oriab, Mnar, the Forbidden Lands, and the Timeless Realm.
Across those locations, the investigators uncovered a total of 4 Signs of the Gods out of the 10 available in the scenario.

storyNotes.title: Scenario III-B: Point of No Return

notes.title: Into The Underworld
items: Because Randolph survived the descent, the waking-world investigators followed his guidance deeper into the Dreamlands' Underworld rather than being left without direction.

The caverns below the Dreamlands were nothing like the marvelous lands and impossible cities from Virgil Gray's account. Instead, the team found a barren, lightless realm that seemed tied to the creatures invading waking reality.

Randolph believed the Underworld might still offer an answer. From the edge of a jagged cliff, he pointed the investigators toward the distant City of Gugs and the southern plains where the ghouls dwell.
The plan was uneasy but clear: find Randolph's acquaintance Richard Pickman, convince the ghouls to help, and use that lead to search for a way back toward the surface of the Dreamlands.

notes.title: The Investigators Achieved Resolution I.
items: The investigators reached Resolution I.
Zoey Samaras, Joe Diamond, and Kymani Jones survived the scenario.
At the end of the scenario, the team escaped the crushing black liquid of the Underworld and emerged into a strange void of suspended rocky platforms and thick webbing.
Record: the investigators found a way out of the Underworld.
Record 2 tally marks next to Steps of the Bridge in Campaign B.
Each Web of Dreams investigator earned 9 XP from the scenario.
Proceed to Interlude III before Scenario IV-B.

notes.title: Dream-Quest Side
items: After Scenario III-A, the dreamers were still pressing toward the Cold Wastes and unknown Kadath, but the journey was taking a visible toll on them.
Because the dreamers grow weaker and the campaign is on Standard difficulty, add a -4 token to Campaign A's chaos bag.
The black cat noticed the dreamers' worsening condition, then warned them that the path to Kadath was bound up with a threat far larger than the Dreamlands alone.
The lead investigator chose to tell the waking-world companions about the threats the dreamers face. Record: the black cat spoke of Nyarlathotep.
Because the Web of Dreams side had possessed the Silver Key, Campaign A now records that the investigators possess the Silver Key, and Silas Marsh earns The Silver Key: Key to the Gate of Dreams.
Campaign A already had the black cat is at your side recorded, so that part caused no additional change.

notes.title: Web of Dreams Side
items: After Scenario III-B, the waking-world investigators reached a cosmic penumbra between worlds, surrounded by webbing and suspended paths over the void.

They found the black cat trapped in the sticky web and freed it. The cat explained that the webbing was a bridge between Earth and the Dreamlands, and that if it were completed the two worlds would merge.

Because Campaign B possessed the Silver Key, the black cat took it from the waking-world investigators and carried it to the Dream-Quest side. The key was removed from the Campaign B deck state and moved to Campaign A.
The cat also delivered the Dream-Quest message: the dreamers were close to Kadath, but the being behind the threat was Nyarlathotep, and they would likely need the cat's help to survive.
Proceed to Scenario IV-B: Weaver of the Cosmos.

storyNotes.title: Scenario IV-B: Weaver of the Cosmos

notes.title: Opening Setup
items: Joe Diamond, Zoey Samaras, and Kymani Jones entered Scenario IV-B: Weaver of the Cosmos as the Campaign B investigators.
The team reached the transdimensional web where the threat behind the waking-world attacks was trying to weave Earth and the Dreamlands together.
The immediate goal was to stop the cosmic bridge before waking reality could be replaced by the nightmare world being formed around Atlach-Nacha.

notes.title: The Spider Queen
items: Campaign log check: Randolph survived the descent, but the black cat does not know the truth, so the first branch did not apply.
Campaign log check: otherwise, because Randolph survived the descent, the second branch applied.
The investigators climbed down toward Atlach-Nacha, but Randolph revealed himself as false, cut the web beneath them, and abandoned them in Atlach-Nacha's realm.
Record: the investigators are trapped in Atlach-Nacha's realm.
If Randolph Carter: Chained to the Waking World is in an investigator deck, remove him for the remainder of the campaign. Recorded here as Joe Diamond losing Randolph from Campaign B deck state.
Because the campaign is on Standard difficulty, add a -4 token to Campaign B's chaos bag.

notes.title: The Investigators Achieved Resolution I.
items: The scenario ended at Resolution 1.
Zoey Samaras, Joe Diamond, and Kymani Jones were all alive at scenario end.
Record: the bridge was destroyed.
Each investigator earned 7 XP from the victory display plus 5 bonus XP for preventing the Dreamlands and Earth from merging, for 12 XP total each.
Because Campaign B had recorded that the investigators found a way out of the Underworld, the topmost applicable follow-up was the branch that leads into Resolution 3.

notes.title: Resolution III Follow-Up
items: The investigators escaped through the route back toward the surface, emerged in the Enchanted Wood, sealed the way behind them, and returned home to waking reality.
Record: the investigators returned to reality.
Zoey Samaras suffers 2 physical trauma.
Joe Diamond suffers 2 physical trauma.
Kymani Jones suffers 2 physical trauma.
Proceed to Scenario IV-A: Where the Gods Dwell.

storyNotes.title: Scenario IV-A: Where the Gods Dwell

notes.title: To The Cold Wastes
items: Campaign log check: the investigators were not carried to the Cold Wastes, so that branch did not apply.
Campaign log check: because the investigators traveled to the Cold Wastes, the White Ship carried the dreamers north to the Plateau of Leng.
The captain warned the investigators that only death waited in this forsaken place, then refused to sail any farther and left them to descend on moonbeams into the frozen waste.
The Dream-Quest investigators continued toward unknown Kadath, climbing higher through snow and onyx until they reached the abandoned halls of the Great Ones.

notes.title: Grand Design
items: The investigators discovered that there were no gods in the onyx halls; the place was long abandoned.
Because Randolph survived the voyage, Randolph accompanied the dreamers into the hall and revealed the truth: he was not Randolph Carter.
Not-Randolph murdered Virgil Gray with a blade of onyx, revealed himself as Nyarlathotep, and claimed that the entire quest had been his design.
If an investigator's deck contains Randolph Carter: Expert Dreamer, remove him for the remainder of the campaign. Recorded here as Wilson Richards losing Randolph from Campaign A deck state.
Because the black cat is at your side, the cat remained with the investigators and acknowledged the tragedy of Virgil's death.

notes.title: The Investigators Achieved Resolution I.
items: The scenario ended at Resolution 1.
Wilson Richards, Silas Marsh, and Mandy Thompson were all alive at scenario end.
Record: the dreamers escaped from Nyarlathotep's grasp.
Each investigator earned 11 XP from the victory display.
Each Dream-Quest investigator suffered 2 mental trauma: Wilson Richards, Silas Marsh, and Mandy Thompson.
The investigators chose to wake up, which led into Resolution 3.

notes.title: Resolution III Follow-Up
items: The dreamers awoke with only hazy fragments of the journey remaining: a black castle, a ship sailing through space, a staircase, and a black cat.
Record: the dreamers awoke.
Proceed to the Epilogue.

notes.title: Epilogue 6
items: Because the dreamers awoke in Campaign A and the investigators returned to reality in Campaign B, Epilogue 6 applied.
The black cat delivered a final wry farewell, telling the reunited investigators to leave their dreams behind or use what they had taken from the dream to shape their destiny.
Record: the two groups were reunited in the waking world.
Record: the investigators win the campaign.

steps.title: 7. Interlude III -> Dream-Quest finale
steps.text: The Great Ones resolved the cross-campaign message after both Scenario III branches. Campaign A added a -4 token, recorded that the black cat spoke of Nyarlathotep, received the Silver Key from Campaign B, and Silas Marsh took The Silver Key.

steps.title: 8. Web of Dreams Scenario IV-B
steps.text: Weaver of the Cosmos ended at Resolution 1, then Resolution 3 applied because the investigators had found a way out of the Underworld. Campaign B destroyed the bridge, returned to reality, added a -4 token, removed Randolph Carter: Chained to the Waking World, and each investigator earned 12 XP while suffering 2 physical trauma.

steps.title: 9. Dream-Quest Scenario IV-A + Epilogue
steps.text: Where the Gods Dwell ended at Resolution 1, then Resolution 3 after the dreamers chose to wake up. Campaign A recorded that the dreamers escaped from Nyarlathotep's grasp and awoke; each investigator earned 11 XP and suffered 2 mental trauma. Epilogue 6 reunited both groups in the waking world and the investigators won the campaign.

crossNotes.title: Cross-Campaign Notes
items: Track any story effects that explicitly carry from one line into the other here.
Keep separate chaos bag updates inside each track unless a rule specifically says the other line changes.
Use the alternating order above when adding scenario records and upgrade entries.
Dream-Quest Scenario I-A already recorded that the dreamers strayed from the path and that the chaos bag reached three skull tokens by scenario end.
Interlude I is one shared event for this run: resolve the Dream-Quest side first, then the Web of Dreams side, and apply the combined results across both campaign logs.
Interlude III moved The Silver Key from Campaign B to Campaign A and revealed Nyarlathotep as the threat behind the dreamers' ordeal.
Scenario IV-B completed Campaign B: the bridge was destroyed, the investigators returned to reality, and the run proceeds to Scenario IV-A for the remaining finale.
Scenario IV-A completed Campaign A: the dreamers escaped Nyarlathotep, awoke, and Epilogue 6 reunited both teams in the waking world for a campaign win.

notes.title: Prologue Summary
items: Date card shown in the campaign guide: Friday, February 13th, 1925.
A strange shared-dream phenomenon is spreading through Arkham after Virgil Gray published an account of an impossible dream journey in Tales from Nevermore.
Multiple readers reported experiencing the exact same dream, drawing the attention of both the Arkham Advertiser and local experts.
Virgil Gray and many others were committed for treatment, but the investigators remain unconvinced that the events can be explained away as ordinary delusion or shared hysteria.
The party decides to recreate Virgil's dream conditions and split responsibilities: one team will travel into the dreamlands while the other remains in the waking world to observe and protect them.
Dream-Quest prologue instruction: proceed to Scenario I-A, Beyond the Gates of Sleep.

notes.title: Scenario I-A Setup Notes
items: At scenario start, each investigator chose a different dream entry as instructed.

Randolph told Virgil about the marvelous city beyond unknown Kadath, and the black cat interrupted the conversation with a warning that the dreamers could not yet return to the waking world.
Because this run is an interconnected eight-part campaign, the lead investigator chose to tell the companions in the waking world that they were in danger and that the dreamers were safe.
Campaign log record added from Interlude I: the black cat warned the others.

Joe Diamond took the optional story asset and earned Randolph Carter: Chained to the Waking World.
Victory display total recorded from the run: 11, so each investigator earned 11 XP from Scenario I-B.
Cleanup instruction noted from the app: remove the infestation bag and all infestation tokens; they do not need to be kept or recorded.

notes.title: Interlude I: The Black Cat (Web of Dreams Side)
items: Following Scenario I-B, the investigators were confronted outside St. Mary's Hospital by the same black cat, who carried a message from the dreamers.
Because this is an interconnected campaign, the Dream-Quest side was resolved first and the selected message delivered here was: tell your companions that they are in danger, and that you are safe.
Campaign log record added on the waking-world side: the black cat warned the others.
The Web of Dreams standalone branch that would record the black cat is at your side was not used for this linked run.
Shared interlude consequence applied: add 1 tablet token to the chaos bag as instructed.
Proceed to Scenario II-B, A Thousand Shapes of Horror.

notes.title: Scenario II-B Result Summary
items: Scenario result: Resolution 1.
All three Web of Dreams investigators resigned alive at scenario end: Zoey Samaras, Joe Diamond, and Kymani Jones.
Campaign log records added: Randolph survived the descent; the investigators possess the Silver Key.
Zoey Samaras took the optional story asset and earned The Silver Key: Key to the Gate of Dreams.
Victory display total recorded from the run: 6, so each investigator earned 6 XP from Scenario II-B.
Ongoing campaign effect: your body now walks within the slumbering Dreamlands; add 1 skull token to Campaign B's chaos bag for the remainder of the campaign.
Next chapter unlocked: proceed to Scenario II-A, The Search for Kadath.

notes.title: Scenario III-B Result Summary
items: Scenario result: Resolution 1.
All three Web of Dreams investigators survived the scenario: Zoey Samaras, Joe Diamond, and Kymani Jones.
Campaign log record added: the investigators found a way out of the Underworld.
Steps of the Bridge increased by 2, reaching 2 total.
Victory display total recorded from the run: 9, so each investigator earned 9 XP from Scenario III-B.
Next chapter unlocked: proceed to Interlude III before Scenario IV-B.

notes.title: Interlude III: The Great Ones (Web of Dreams Side)
items: Following Scenario III-B, the waking-world investigators reached the webbed bridge between Earth and the Dreamlands and freed the black cat from the sticky strands.
The black cat explained that the bridge would merge the two worlds if completed, making it the immediate threat that Campaign B must stop.
The Silver Key was removed from Campaign B's deck state and carried to Campaign A, while the Campaign B history still records that the investigators had possessed it.
The black cat passed along the Dream-Quest warning about Nyarlathotep, then left to help the dreamers.
Next chapter unlocked: proceed to Scenario IV-B, Weaver of the Cosmos.

notes.title: Scenario IV-B Result Summary
items: Opening state: Joe Diamond, Zoey Samaras, and Kymani Jones entered the cosmic web to stop Atlach-Nacha from joining Earth and the Dreamlands.
Branch checks: the black cat did not know the truth, but Randolph survived the descent, so the Randolph betrayal branch applied.
Campaign log records added: the investigators are trapped in Atlach-Nacha's realm; the bridge was destroyed; the investigators returned to reality.
Player card change recorded: Randolph Carter: Chained to the Waking World was removed from Joe Diamond's deck for the remainder of the campaign.
Chaos bag update applied: add a -4 token to Campaign B on Standard difficulty.
Scenario result: Resolution 1, then Resolution 3 because the investigators had found a way out of the Underworld.
XP recorded: victory display 7 plus 5 bonus XP, for 12 XP each.
Trauma recorded: Zoey Samaras, Joe Diamond, and Kymani Jones each suffer 2 physical trauma.
Next chapter unlocked: proceed to Scenario IV-A, Where the Gods Dwell.

scenarios.title: Prologue -> Scenario I-B
scenarios.text: The waking-world investigators brought their companions to St. Mary's Hospital, recruited Doctor Maheswaran to accompany them, and completed Waking Nightmare at Resolution 1 with the hospital escape aftermath recorded.

scenarios.title: Interlude I -> Scenario II-B
scenarios.text: After Waking Nightmare and the linked Black Cat interlude, the waking-world team entered A Thousand Shapes of Horror, resigned alive at Resolution 1, and carried The Silver Key forward into Campaign B.

scenarios.title: Scenario III-B
scenarios.text: Point of No Return ended at Resolution 1. The team survived, found a way out of the Underworld, recorded 2 tally marks next to Steps of the Bridge, and earned 9 XP each.

scenarios.title: Scenario IV-B
scenarios.text: Weaver of the Cosmos ended at Resolution 1, with Resolution 3 applied afterward. The bridge was destroyed, the investigators returned to reality, each investigator earned 12 XP and suffered 2 physical trauma, and the run proceeds to Scenario IV-A.

scenarios.title: Epilogue
scenarios.text: Because the dreamers awoke and the waking-world investigators returned to reality, Epilogue 6 reunited both groups and the investigators won the campaign.
